pr_title: Made the encodings of .razor and .cshtml files in the repo consistent
pr_body:
Fixes https://github.com/dotnet/aspnetcore/issues/22753

- 99% of the changes in this PR is adding UTF8BOM to .cshtml and .razor files in the repo.
- See the second commit for the test fixes
pr_comments: @mkArtakMSFT this is ready to be merged

issue_context.title: Inconsistent file encodings in Blazor project templates
issue_context.body: After doing a quick sanity check, I noticed that some files contain BOM and some don't. We need to make them consistent. There is a [test](https://github.com/dotnet/aspnetcore/blob/78d6ce201ff955bac07899bdc7c54abe6bd57125/src/ProjectTemplates/test/ByteOrderMarkTest.cs#L67) that is supposed to verify that it didn't happen but looks like it was skipped when we moved to Helix. We need to unskip that test to catch bugs like these in the future.
comments:
Thanks @ajaybhargavb!
Can you please handle this then? Given that you have context on what needs to happen and the test too.
